name: Resume.AI
subtitle: Feedback, Score & AI Coaching
promotionalText: Review a PDF or pasted resume with a transparent readiness score and optional AI coaching. Save or share reports only when you choose.
description:
Review your resume with two clearly separated signals: a deterministic readiness score and optional AI coaching.

HOW IT WORKS

• Paste resume text or choose a readable PDF.
• Add an optional role description for relevant-term feedback.
• Review what will be submitted and consent before analysis.
• See structure, impact, readability, and relevant-term components.
• Review strengths, improvements, and draft bullet ideas.
• Save a bounded report locally only when you choose.
• Share a text summary or temporary PDF report through the iOS share sheet.

PRIVACY CONTROLS

Scanned-PDF text recognition uses Apple Vision on your device. Recognized text stays on the device until you review it and consent. Standard PDFs are transiently sent to the Resume.AI service for text extraction; raw PDF bytes are not sent to the AI provider. Reviewed resume text and any optional role description are sent to Groq only after consent. The service keeps no report or content history. No account, ads, tracking, or third-party analytics are used. Optional saved reports remain in the app's local store and may be included in device backups.

IMPORTANT LIMITS

The readiness score is deterministic coaching feedback. It is not an employer's ATS and not a hiring decision. AI feedback may be incomplete or wrong and may restate submitted content. Resume.AI does not predict or guarantee interviews, jobs, or application outcomes. Review every suggestion before editing, saving, or sharing your material.
submissionBlockers: Confirm seller and copyright values in the authorized App Store Connect account.
Deploy and anonymously verify the production API, privacy URL, and support URL.
Verify Groq retention settings in the authoritative console.
Complete physical-iPhone, backup and restore, signed build, and TestFlight gates.
Capture required screenshots from the accepted TestFlight binary with synthetic content.
Obtain explicit authorization before upload or submission.
